notes.title: Achievements, Trading Cards & Better Keyboard Controls! (Version 1.0.1)
notes.notes:
Hey guys! We just pushed up an update that fixes a few minor technical issues and spelling errors, as well as adds achievements, trading cards, and better keyboard controls!

The achievements are pretty straight forward for this game. For every badge you earn you'll also be rewarded with a steam achievement now too. These are retroactive so all you have to do to collect the achievements you've already earned is boot up the game and load into your save.

The changes to the keyboard controls are:

+ Interact is now "C" (formerly "Q")
+ Secondary interact is now "X" (formerly "W")
+ Run/Dig/Cancel is now "Z" (formerly "E")

We feel this is a much more natural/comfortable layout and make certain tasks like running around less awkward. Let us know what you think.

Thanks!
